USAGE:
    bnl-dotnet [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    bnl-dotnet basic
    bnl-dotnet basic --interactive
    bnl-dotnet basic OrderService.Create
    bnl-dotnet basic ./MyApi.csproj OrderService.Create(int)
    bnl-dotnet endpoint

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    basic       Free. Diagram a single method in isolation - no composition, no 
                license needed. Give no method to list them                     
    endpoint    Paid. Controller actions (ASP.NET Core Web API entry points).   
                Give no action to list them                                     
    method      Paid. Any analyzable method, not just controller actions. Give  
                no method to list them                                          
    license     Activate a license key, or show the current license with        
                --status

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Free. Diagram a single method in isolation - no composition, no license needed. 
Give no method to list them

USAGE:
    bnl-dotnet basic [path-or-method] [method] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    bnl-dotnet basic
    bnl-dotnet basic --interactive
    bnl-dotnet basic OrderService.Create
    bnl-dotnet basic ./MyApi.csproj OrderService.Create(int)

ARGUMENTS:
    [path-or-method]    A .sln, .slnx or .csproj (or a folder containing one).  
                        Omit to use the one in the current folder; if it's not a
                        project, it's read as the method instead                
    [method]            The method to diagram, e.g. OrdersController.Get or     
                        OrdersController.Get(int). Omit to list what's available

OPTIONS:
                             DEFAULT                                            
    -h, --help                          Prints help information                 
    -o, --output                        File to write the diagram to, or a      
                                        folder to write <Type.Method>.mmd (.md, 
                                        .drawio, .json) into. Defaults to the   
                                        current folder                          
        --stdout                        Write the diagram to STDOUT and nothing 
                                        else (for redirects and pipes). Cannot  
                                        be combined with -o                     
    -f, --format <FORMAT>    mermaid    mermaid (bare diagram text, .mmd),      
                                        markdown (wrapped in a ```mermaid fence,
                                        .md) or advanced (variable-flow diagram 
                                        for draw.io, .drawio; 'drawio' also     
                                        works) or json (the Mermaid text plus   
                                        each node's source location, .json;     
                                        basic only
[truncated]

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Activate a license key, or show the current license with --status

USAGE:
    bnl-dotnet license [key] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    bnl-dotnet license dgcli_...
    bnl-dotnet license --status

ARGUMENTS:
    [key]    The license key from your dotnet.boxesnlines.com purchase/renewal  
             email                                                              

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help      Prints help information                                     
        --stdin     Read the key from standard input instead of the command line
        --status    Print the current license as JSON (tier, email, expiry) and 
                    change nothing
